question: Which instrument is commonly used as a prop during the performance of Pandavani in Chhattisgarh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tambura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Pandavani** is a traditional folk ballad form from **Chhattisgarh** that narrates tales from the ancient Indian epic, the **Mahabharata**.

• The lead narrator, known as the **Ragi**, prominently uses the **Tambura** (also called **Tanpura**) as both a musical instrument and a versatile **theatrical prop**.

• The **Tambura** used in this folk form is often decorated with **peacock feathers** and **small bells**, giving it a distinct visual identity associated with the performer.

• During the performance, the artist symbolically uses the **Tambura** to represent different objects, such as the **Gada** (mace) of **Bhima**, a bow, or a sword, to enhance the storytelling through **gestures**.

• The instrument provides a continuous **drone sound**, helping the performer maintain the pitch while shifting between singing and high-energy narration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Performance Styles**:

• **Vedamati Style**: The performer remains **seated** on the floor throughout the recital, focusing more on the vocal delivery.

• **Kapalik Style**: The performer is **mobile**, dancing and enacting characters, where the **Tambura** becomes a dynamic tool for dramatization.

• **Renowned Exponents**:

• **Teejan Bai**: A legendary artist of the **Kapalik style** who brought international fame to **Pandavani** and received the **Padma Vibhushan**.

• **Punaram Nishad**: A celebrated figure known for his mastery over the **Vedamati style** of narration.

• **Accompanying Instruments**:

• While the **Tambura** is the central prop, the ensemble typically includes the **Harmonium**, **Tabla**, **Dholak**, and **Manjira** (cymbals) to provide rhythmic and melodic support.
